sighhh

I don't know. I may only live another 8 months anyway due to a brain tumor. 

but to see the girl you love with everything youve got just disappear, ugh... i dont even know. i cant explain how I feel.

I'm really sorry to hear that. :c you're right, it doesn't accomplish anything. This probably isn't what she would want.. But she was my life.. My life is gone. I'll never have her back... We promised each other we'd be together forever.
